comparison_method: Parse SVG XML; expand relative/absolute M/L/H/V/C/S/Z path syntax to absolute M/L/C/Z coordinates (4 decimal places), retaining every shape and animation. Canonicalize time syntax .4s/0.4s, local mask identifier names, and default black mask fill. Ignore only root class/width/height/aria-hidden and the transparent canvas path. Compare the complete normalized node tree and all remaining attributes.
